documents.title: Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 To Be Held On October 29, 2026.

Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, October 23, 2026 - Substitution Of Proposed Allottees And Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 Of D. P. Abhushan Limited
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited reported a 58% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 853.63 crores for Q1 FY27, driven by wedding and festive demand. EBITDA for the quarter rose 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores with margins expanding to 11.01%. Management highlighted plans to open five to six new stores in the current fiscal year and aims to reach a total store count of 51 by FY30. Additionally, the company targeted approximately 10% volume growth for FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: The company targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: Management aims to reach a overall store count of 51 stores, with the majority under the COCO model.
guidance.quote: Yes, Vikas here, our overall plan remains broadly unchanged we aim to reach a total of 51 stores, and the majority of these will continue to be under the Company-Owned, Company-Operated (COCO) model.

guidance.claim: The company targets adding approximately five to six new stores during the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

guidance.claim: Management targets increasing the studded mix to between 12% and 15% by March 2028.
guidance.quote: As of now our business is doing like between 6% to 7% of the studded mix. And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: The company plans to expand its retail presence across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities in five states over the upcoming five years.
guidance.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

guidance.claim: Management targets annual topline growth of approximately 25% to 30% by the end of 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: The company expects EBITDA margin to be around 6% to 6.5% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: Management projects revenue of INR4,800 crores for FY27 and INR5,500 crores for the next year.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The company targets EBITDA margins between 8% and 8.5% by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

guidance.claim: Management targets a total of around 51 stores by 2030.
guidance.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: The store footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81% during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

demand_outlook.claim: The average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000 in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: During the quarter, our average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000, supported by wedding-led purchases and festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall same-store sales growth reached 52% during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume growth for Q1 FY27 stood at approximately 1% to 2% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: When we compare Q1 FY27 with Q1 FY26, we have delivered volume growth of approximately 1% to 2%.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand stayed healthy during Q1 FY27 across markets, driven by consumption and investment purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange contributed approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The company saw encouraging traction in its gold exchange business and D.P. Swarna Plus Scheme.
demand_outlook.quote: We witnessed encouraging traction in our gold exchange business and D.P. Swarna Plus Scheme, reflecting customers' increasing preference for planned jewellery purchases and efficient monetisation of existing gold holdings.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding and cultural demand remain resilient despite elevated gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Even in periods of elevated gold prices, we continue to see jewellery demand remain resilient, especially in wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets like ours.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising gold prices have shifted consumer preferences towards lighter daily-wear and minimalist designs.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter designs. Daily-wear gold, studded jewellery, and minimalist designs are gaining popularity

demand_outlook.claim: Same-store sales growth stood at approximately 20% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: So yeah, the number of the same-store sales growth is ~20% is the SSG growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume growth experienced a decline of around 20% overall in FY26 due to high gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall.

capex_expansion.claim: Locations for new showrooms have been finalized in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Under this roadmap, we have successfully finalized the locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahod showroom will measure around 3,200 sq. ft. under a COCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jabalpur showroom will span about 3,750 sq. ft. and mark the company's first FOCO store.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second showroom, in Jabalpur, will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and will be our first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched its e-commerce website and mobile application across major mobile application platforms.
capex_expansion.quote: This quarter, we launched our e-commerce website and mobile application, which are now available on both the Play Store and App Store.

capex_expansion.claim: Location agreements and approvals have been finalized for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully finalized locations for its upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat, with all key agreements, approvals, and necessary formalities completed.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated a new showroom in Dhar, taking the total showroom network to 12.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capex_expansion.claim: The company planned to open three to four new stores for the year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to expand retail footprints in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Chhattisgarh.
capex_expansion.quote: Going ahead, we aim to expand our footprints in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, through a disciplined, research-led approach backed by detailed regional analysis, customer preferences.

capex_expansion.claim: The company targets Jaipur for expansion in the next one to two years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: At operating level, EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR93.99 crores in Q1 '27 as compared to INR55 crores in Q1 '26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin improved by 82 basis points year-on-year to 7.55% during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin expanded to 7.55%, up 82 basis points year-on-year, reflecting strong profitability growth and sustained efficiency across the businesses.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gains accounted for only around 10% to 15% of the quarterly growth.
margins_costs.quote: For the current quarter, only around 10% to 15% of the growth can be attributed to inventory gains.

margins_costs.claim: D.P. Abhushan uses Gold Metal Loans and hedging mechanisms to lessen gold price volatility and preserve margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: Continue to follow a disciplined approach towards gold procurement and inventory management, exchange gold, leveraging Gold Metal Loans (GMLs) and hedging mechanisms at commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility while supporting margin stability and working capital efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 5.45%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 5.45%.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA margins improved to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins are expected to maintain approximately 10% to 11%.
margins_costs.quote: As far as gross margins are concerned, we expect the business to maintain approximately 10% to 11%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total revenue for Q1 FY27 reached INR 853.63 crores, representing a 58% YoY increase.
orders_capacity.quote: During Quarter 1 '27, our total revenue stood at INR853.63 crores as compared to INR541 crores in Quarter 1 FY26, registering a strong growth of 58% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Wedding-related sales accounted for 62% of product category sales in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of product category mix, wedding related purchases remained the largest contributor, accounting for 62% of the sales during the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently operates with an annual inventory turnover ratio of approximately 4.7x to 5.0x.
orders_capacity.quote: Our business currently operates with an inventory turnover ratio of around 4.7x to 5.0x annually, which, in our view, is among the best in the industry.

orders_capacity.claim: First-quarter revenue increased by 58% YoY, boosted by festive purchases during Akshaya Tritiya, Poila Baisakh, Baisakhi, and the summer wedding season.
orders_capacity.quote: Revenue grew by 58 % YoY, supported by strong festive purchases during key occasions such as Akshaya Tritiya, Poila Baisakh, Baisakhi, along with the onset of the summer wedding season.

orders_capacity.claim: Centralized purchasing in Ratlam supports smooth inventory flow and operational efficiency across stores within 300 kilometers.
orders_capacity.quote: Centralized purchasing at Ratlam ensures smooth inventory flow, minimizing dead stock and maximizing operational efficiency across all stores within a 300-kilometer radius

orders_capacity.claim: Total retail store area stood at approximately 53,650 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Average revenue delivered was ~INR7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR339 crores per store for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: On the productivity front, we delivered an average revenue of ~INR7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR339 crores per store for FY26, reflecting strong store-level performance and efficient utilization of retail space.

orders_capacity.claim: Inventory turnover stood at approximately 4.7x for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: while inventory turnover stood at ~4.7x, highlighting efficient inventory management and faster stock rotation.

orders_capacity.claim: Store-level conversion remained largely stable at approximately 82% to 83%.
orders_capacity.quote: while overall conversion has remained largely stable at ~82%–83%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilizes gold metal loans, exchange-led procurement, and MCX hedging to manage working capital and price risks.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to leverage exchange led procurement of gold, gold metal loan, and hedging mechanisms on the commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility, support margin stability, and improve working capital efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: Inventory comprises approximately 95% to 98% of the company's total assets.
capital_allocation.quote: When we look at our balance sheet, almost 95% to 98% of our assets consist of inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is working to lower dependence on fresh gold procurement using exchange schemes and gold accumulation plans to improve capital efficiency.
capital_allocation.quote: Reducing dependence on fresh gold procurement through exchange-led scheme and Structured Gold Savings Accumulation Scheme, thereby improving capital efficiency and sustaining sales even at higher gold prices.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's planned QIP has been put on hold because market conditions are not favorable.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable.

capital_allocation.claim: Expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be executed through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not planned for any long-term borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: No, we have not yet planned for any long-term borrowings.

risks_headwinds.claim: The increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 created near-term cost and demand sensitivities.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact, supported by India’s cultural affinity for gold, wedding and festive led demand, rising formalisation, omnichannel adoption.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Adhik Maas period fell completely within the first quarter of FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are pleased to commence FY27 with a healthy performance in the first quarter despite the Adhik Maas period falling entirely within the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The government raised the import duty on gold and silver from approximately 6% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Government raised the import duty on gold (and silver) from ~6% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: India's gold demand is projected to stay between 600–700 tonnes in 2026 as high gold prices weaken jewellery consumption.
risks_headwinds.quote: India’s gold demand is projected to remain in the range of 600–700 tonnes in 2026, with rising investment demand offsetting weaker jewellery consumption due to elevated gold prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted recent industry-wide discussion around customs duty changes and comments regarding mindful spending practices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Over the past few weeks, there has also been industry-wide discussion around the recent customs duty changes and the Honourable Prime Minister’s comments regarding mindful spending practices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold price volatility and geopolitical situations impacted gross margins during the final quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: See Chetan, the gold prices was playing a very important role in the last quarter, which everybody has visualized, because of the geopolitical situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality, such as June and July seeing relatively lower demand after the wedding season.
risks_headwinds.quote: That said, demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality. For instance, the wedding season has recently concluded, and months like June and July typically see relatively lower demand.

management_commitments.claim: D.P. Abhushan targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets adding approximately five to six new stores in the current fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase its overall studded mix to 12% to 15% by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: As of now our business is doing like between 6% to 7% of the studded mix. And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach a overall network of 51 stores.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, Vikas here, our overall plan remains broadly unchanged we aim to reach a total of 51 stores, and the majority of these will continue to be under the Company-Owned, Company-Operated (COCO) model.

management_commitments.claim: D.P. Abhushan plans to expand into Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, and Maharashtra over the upcoming 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: Showroom development and fit-outs for the upcoming Jabalpur and Dahod stores are underway and expected to become operational shortly.
management_commitments.quote: Fit-out and showroom development activities are progressing at both locations, and the stores are expected to become operational shortly.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30% by the end of 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to open three to four new stores for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5% as part of its FY30 vision.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

management_commitments.claim: Management is targeting a topline growth of approximately 25% to 30% annually by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: On the long-term growth front, we are targeting a topline growth of approximately 25% to 30% annually.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to target Jaipur for expansion in the next one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
